acceptance: A scheduled refresh pull request with an unrewritten bot commit is observed through one arm attempt after an owner stand-in, and the outcome is recorded with GitHub's merge state.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
This item first said the develop ruleset's unattributed-commit rule blocks refresh pull requests because they commit as `benchbox-bot <bot@benchbox.dev>`. Evidence read on 2026-11-20 does not support that: #3914, #3915, #4004, #4090 and #4317 each merged with a sole commit by that identity and no linked account; #4090 and #4317 merged under the ruleset version last changed on 2026-11-10; #4317 merged by auto-merge on 2026-11-18. None had an approving review. What the stalled scheduled refreshes (#3928, #4066, #4283, and medium-shard #4284) share is that the review bot marks them too large to review, the required `review-gate` check fails, and nobody posts a stand-in. Why #4381's first head f734774a sat for 15 minutes with every required check green and auto-merge on (core green 16:29:30Z, force-push 16:45:20Z on 2026-11-19) is unexplained.

## Owner decision
Question: why refresh pull requests stall, and the bot identity. Answer: "Recommended: leave the identity alone. Add only a visible failure when a scheduled refresh opens while the previous one is still open. On the next scheduled refresh (Monday 23 Nov) you post the stand-in, I arm once with no re-authoring, and we see whether it merges." Source: owner's answer in the choice dialog, 2026-11-20.

## Change
No workflow identity change. When the scheduled fast-tier refresh pull request of 2026-11-23 opens, tell the owner its number and head. After the owner posts the stand-in, run `make pr-arm` once and record what GitHub reports: merged, or blocked with the merge state and every required check's state.

## Decision gates
Held until 2026-11-23T17:00Z. The stand-in is the owner's to post, naming that pull request and head at the time. No agent re-authors, amends or force-pushes a refresh commit. If it does not merge, record the evidence and stop; a ruleset or identity change is owner-only.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the item records the pull request number, head, the commit author, the stand-in comment's time, the single `make pr-arm` output and the final state read from GitHub.

## Guardrails (accepted by the owner, 2026-11-20)
The agent never posts a stand-in review, resolves a review thread, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
